item.title: Timothée Chalamet loses 110k followers after opera remarks
item.description: Timothée Chalamet lost nearly 110,000 Instagram followers and an estimated $1,200 in potential earnings per post after a viral video showed him claiming "no one cares" about opera or ballet, while his latest film, "Marty Supreme," saw significantly lower search interest than the art forms mentioned in his comments.

item.title: Wendy's tops burger reviews, McDonald's faces challenges
item.description: Wendy's has been ranked as having the best fast-food burgers in the US, while McDonald's received the lowest rating among major national chains, according to a new analysis of customer reviews.

item.title: Texas dubbed unluckiest state due to frequent disasters
item.description: Texas was ranked as the unluckiest state in the nation due to its high injury rates, frequent natural disasters, and low average credit score, according to a recent study by The Action Network.

item.title: Pie Five offers weeklong BOGO pizzas for Pi Day
item.description: Pie Five is offering a weeklong buy-one-get-one personal pizza deal at participating locations nationwide from March 9-15 to celebrate National Pi Day, with the discount automatically applied to the lower-priced item for Circle of Crust loyalty members and available to the general public on March 14.

item.title: Milagro Tequila hosts Chow Chow House event in Dallas
item.description: Milagro Tequila is bringing the Mexico City social club Chow Chow House to Dallas for a guest bartending event on March 23, featuring world-class cocktails and showcasing the intersection of cocktail culture and the energy of the Mexican capital.

item.title: Dinosaur World Texas unveils new attractions for spring break
item.description: Dinosaur World in Glen Rose is offering a fun, affordable, and kid-approved Spring Break spot with new attractions, including a train, splash pad, and hands-on activities.

item.title: Study ranks the hardest-working musicians in the world
item.description: Elton John has been named the hardest-working musician in a new study, having performed 4,805 shows and traveled over 2.36 million miles throughout his career.

item.title: Three commutes Texans are most furious about
item.description: A new survey of 3,015 U.S. workers has identified the three most stressful commutes for Texas drivers.

item.title: Rooftop Cinema Club hosts Disney film for St. Patrick's Day
item.description: Rooftop Cinema Club will celebrate St. Patrick's Day with an outdoor rooftop screening of the Disney movie "Luck of the Irish" on March 17, featuring skyline views, fire pits, complimentary hot cocoa, and holiday-themed surprises.

item.title: Texas dog missing for years found in New Jersey
item.description: A dog named Koko was found in Clark, New Jersey and reunited with its owner in Texas after being missing for two years.
